description: Test file for validating RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) objects in Kubernetes, including ClusterRoleBinding, RoleBinding, Role, and ClusterRole validation functions and their associated test cases.

methods.name: TestValidateClusterRoleBinding
methods.description: Tests validation of ClusterRoleBinding objects, including success and various failure cases.

methods.name: TestValidateRoleBinding
methods.description: Tests validation of RoleBinding objects, including success and various failure cases.

methods.name: TestValidateRoleBindingUpdate
methods.description: Tests validation of updates to RoleBinding objects, ensuring immutable fields are enforced.

methods.name: TestValidateRoleZeroLengthNamespace
methods.description: Checks that a Role with missing namespace fails validation.

methods.name: TestValidateRoleZeroLengthName
methods.description: Checks that a Role with missing name fails validation.

methods.name: TestValidateRoleNonResourceURL
methods.description: Validates a ClusterRole with non-resource URLs.

methods.name: TestValidateRoleNamespacedNonResourceURL
methods.description: Checks that non-resource URLs in a namespaced Role are invalid.

methods.name: TestValidateRoleNonResourceURLNoVerbs
methods.description: Checks that non-resource URLs require verbs.

methods.name: TestValidateRoleMixedNonResourceAndResource
methods.description: Ensures that non-resource URLs cannot be combined with resource rules in a Role.

methods.name: TestValidateRoleValidResource
methods.description: Validates a Role with proper resource rules.

methods.name: TestValidateRoleNoAPIGroup
methods.description: Checks that API groups are required in resource rules.

methods.name: TestValidateRoleNoResources
methods.description: Checks that resources are required in resource rules.
